name: Sandboxed Tools
description: OS-level sandboxed Bash / Edit / Write / text_editor tools (ADR-0028). When a session enables sandbox mode the SDK builtins are replaced by these, which route through the host's sandbox backend: the sandbox_exec command on the Tauri desktop, or the cognia-sandbox-exec helper on a Node host. A host with neither refuses the call instead of running it unconfined.
author: cognia-next

browser.hint: Sandboxed execution needs an OS sandbox backend on the host. The Tauri desktop has one, and a Node host (the cognia-agent CLI, the supervised brain) registers the cognia-sandbox-exec helper at bootstrap. Where neither is present, such as a plain browser tab, every call is refused with that reason rather than running unconfined.

mobile.reason: OS sandbox backends (bwrap / sandbox-exec) run in the desktop shell — unavailable on mobile.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 沙箱工具
